before.name: Reading First grade 1 comprehension impact: SAT 10 points (2005-2007)
before.description: Adjusted reading-comprehension impact pooled across three spring assessments. The confidence interval includes zero; the estimate is not evidence of exactly no effect.

after.name: Reading First's estimated grade 1 comprehension score increase of 4.74 SAT 10 points was not statistically significant.
after.description: Pooled springs 2005–2007: adjusted funding impact 4.74 SAT 10 scaled-score points versus estimated outcomes without funding (SE 2.72; 95% CI -0.63 to 10.11; p = 0.083). RFIS Exhibits 2.5 and D.1 report this native-unit estimate for sampled U.S. schools.

before.name: Reading First grade 1: Reading comprehension scaled score (SD)
before.description: Adjusted impact on student achievement. Native and standardized versions of this outcome share the same study contrast.

after.name: Reading First's estimated grade 1 comprehension score increase of 0.10 SD was not statistically significant.
after.description: Pooled springs 2005–2007: adjusted funding impact 0.10 standard deviations versus estimated outcomes without funding (SE 0.06; 95% CI -0.01 to 0.21; p = 0.083). RFIS Exhibits 2.5 and D.1 report this standardized form of the same contrast for sampled U.S. schools.

estimate.normalization: Non-Reading First outcome SD pooled across spring 2005 and 2006 SAT 10 scores, separately by grade.
